items.lede: On Reddit and Discord, people addicted to opioids say SR-17018 can remove withdrawal symptoms. Despite its potential, the DEA has placed it in the same category as heroin.
items.title: Opioid Users Found a ‘Miracle Drug’ to Help Them Quit. Then the DEA Banned It

items.lede: Researchers say the Schedule I ban could kill studies of a promising opioid treatment.
items.title: The DEA banned a drug some opioid users called a miracle
